snippet.title: The Gate Must Stand Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Fend off brutal waves of demonic hordes as a mobile hero amongst your stationary allies. As the city’s last line of defense, recruit followers, unlock upgrades, and synergize skills to hold the line against apocalyptic bosses. Remember: heroes can fall, but the gate must stand.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3975750/The_Gate_Must_Stand/
